evidence.title: QUASAR: A Quantum-Classical Neural Network for SAR Satellite Physical-Layer Authentication

summary: A new system called QUASAR combines quantum computing with classical neural networks to perform physical‑layer authentication of synthetic‑aperture radar (SAR) satellite transmissions. The approach promises enhanced security and robustness against spoofing attacks in satellite communications.
title: Researchers unveil QUASAR, a hybrid quantum‑classical neural network for authenticating SAR satellite signals
